No black blocks, heavy eyeliner, extra shadow, blur, smudging, orange/red skin, contrast boost, iris drift, larger eyes, white flashes, text, labels, borders, gutters or watermark.
visibleIssues: V-shaped brows read more clearly. At enlarged atlas view, brow strokes may look heavier than original; parent should compare original color and native thickness. No further generation performed.
